title: Three Similar Words · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Three Similar Words · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a common adjective such as happy or large. The lead gives three different words with approximately the same meaning. The group agrees the three words are reasonable synonyms in ordinary use. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Three Similar Words, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group agrees the three words are reasonable synonyms in ordinary use.
recall.why: The group agrees the three words are reasonable synonyms in ordinary use.
